The tyres on all Fiat Panda 4x4 versions have been designed to give the best balance between performance on proper roads and performance on unmade roads and/or snow covered or icy surfaces.

These tyres feature good properties for off road usage conditions and good driveability on both snow covered/icy surfaces and dry or wet surfaces.
